questions.stem: What is the function of the sperm duct (vas deferens)?

options.text: To carry sperm from the testes to the urethra
To store urine before it leaves the body

questions.explanation: The sperm duct (vas deferens) is a muscular tube that carries sperm from each testis to the urethra, where it mixes with fluids from glands to form semen.
